head: codex/5664-runtime-v3-protocol-adapters
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][protocols] Provider/ACIP/A2A/Cloud Bridge adapter slice (#5664)
body: Adapter-slice-only publication attempt for #5664. This current diff preserves the tested Provider, ACIP, A2A, and Cloud Bridge protocol adapter implementation and tests. It does not claim full runtime completion: production serve wiring remains limited by current typed ownership of adl-runtime-kernel/src/bin/adl-runtime-kernel.rs, and stale shared-path ownership remains in the #5664 claim. Validation already run for the disjoint adapter slice: protocol_adapters test and strict Clippy passed.
